fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook, redfish early/late, pompano, whiting, jacks, Spanish mackerel, flounder (Blind/Stump Pass, beaches). LEMON BAY: redfish schools, mangrove snapper, snook into ICW. NEARSHORE: red/gag grouper, snapper. Baits: shrimp, soft plastics, live bait, pompano jigs.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no effects, no fish kills or respiratory irritation.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (latest ~10 CFU/100mL enterococci).
